description_en: Retrieves the description of a DataAgent session
kebab_example: aliyun dms describe-data-agent-session --dms-unit cn-hangzhou --session-id c61n7gm000000rj --workspace-id 120000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDataAgentSession

parameters.help_en: The DataAgent session ID. You can obtain this ID by calling CreateDataAgentSession
parameters.name: session_id

Artifacts.description_en: The list of artifacts produced by the session. Currently, only reports are included
Artifacts.description_zh: 会话产出的产物列表。当前只包含报告

Description.description_en: The brief description of the artifact. This value may be empty
Description.description_zh: 产物的简要描述，可能为空

FinishTime.description_en: The time when the backend completed the artifact task. This is a UNIX timestamp accurate to the second
FinishTime.description_zh: 后端完成该产物任务的时间。UNIX时间戳，精确到秒

Id.description_en: The globally unique artifact ID. If the report is produced by calling SendChatMessage with MessageType set to REPORT, the artifact ID is the same as the MessageId in the response of the SendChatMessage operation
Id.description_zh: 产物ID，全局唯一。如果是通过SendChatMessage指定MessageType为REPORT产出的报告，则产物ID会和SendChatMessage接口返回值中的MessageId保持一致

Name.description_en: The artifact name. This is typically a string concatenated by the system and is aligned with the name field in the ListFileUpload operation. You can use this field to query the download URL of the artifact file
Name.description_zh: 产物名称，通常为工程拼接的字符串，会和LIstFileUpload接口的name字段对齐，可以通过该字段关联查询到产物文件的下载链接

ReceiveTime.description_en: The time when the backend received the artifact request. This is a UNIX timestamp accurate to the second
ReceiveTime.description_zh: 后端收到该产物请求的时间，UNIX时间戳，精确到秒

StartTime.description_en: The time when the backend actually started running the artifact task. This is a UNIX timestamp accurate to the second
StartTime.description_zh: 后端实际开始运行该产物任务的时间。UNIX时间戳，精确到秒

Status.description_en:
The artifact status. Valid values:

PENDING: The backend has received the task but has not started it.

RUNNING: The backend has started the task but has not completed it.

SUCCESS: The task succeeded. You can query the file information by calling the ListFileUpload operation.

FAILED: The task failed
Status.description_zh:
产物状态。当前可能为如下枚举之一：

PENDING，表示后端已收到任务，尚未启动

RUNNING，表示后端已启动任务，尚未完成

SUCCESS，表示任务已成功，可在LIstFileUpload接口中查询到文件信息

FAILED，表示任务已失败

Type.description_en: The artifact type. Valid values: TextReport, WebReport
Type.description_zh: 产物类型。当前可能为：[TextReport, WebReport]

items.description_en: The element of the chat replay history

Key.description_en: The key of the chat replay history

Url.description_en: The OSS download URL of the chat replay history
Url.description_zh: 会话回放历史的OSS下载链接

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the session was created

DataSources.description_en: The list of data sources used in the current session
DataSources.description_zh: 当前会话用到的数据源列表

Category.description_en:
The data source category. Valid values:

CHAT: specified through the CreateDataAgentSession or SendChatMessage operation during a conversation.

CUSTOM_AGENT: from the preset analysis data scope in a custom agent
Category.description_zh:
数据源来源。当前包含如下枚举

CHAT: 来自对话中通过CreateDataAgentSession或SendChatMessage接口指定

CUSTOM_AGENT: 来自自定义Agent中预设的分析数据范围

Detail.description_en:
The data source details.

When Category is CHAT or CUSTOM_AGENT, the structure of Detail is aligned with the structure of a single element in the DataSources parameter of the SendChatMessage operation
Detail.description_zh:
数据源详情。

当Category是CHAT或者CUSTOM_AGENT的时候，Detail的结构和SendChatMessage接口的DataSources中单个元素的结构是对齐的

FavoriteInWorkspace.description_en: Indicates whether the session is saved as a favorite in the workspace by the current logged-in user
FavoriteInWorkspace.description_zh: 是否在工作空间中被当前登录人收藏

RecallResults.description_en: The recall results from the knowledge base and memory for the current session
RecallResults.description_zh: 本次会话在知识库、记忆召回的结果

Content.description_en: The content of the recalled knowledge chunk

Score.description_en: The similarity score of this data entry. The scoring algorithm is related to the algorithm (l2/ip/cosine) specified when the index was created
Score.description_zh: 此条数据的相似度分数，其分数算法和创建索引时指定的算法(l2/ip/cosine)相关

Type.description_en: The type of the recalled knowledge

Saved.description_en: Indicates whether the session is saved as a favorite by the current logged-in user
Saved.description_zh: 是否被当前登录人收藏

CustomAgentStage.description_en:
The stage of the custom agent. Valid values:
debug: test stage.
prod: production stage
CustomAgentStage.description_zh:
自定义Agent的使用阶段：
debug 调试阶段
prod 正式生产阶段

EnableSearch.description_en: Specifies whether to enable web search

EncryptKey.description_en: The encryption key for storing artifacts in OSS (both built-in and user-specified). This is typically specified in CreateDataAgentSession
EncryptKey.description_zh: 产物存放到OSS（含内置和用户）的加密秘钥，通常在CreateDataAgentSession中指定

EncryptType.description_en: The encryption type for storing artifacts in OSS (both built-in and user-specified)
EncryptType.description_zh: 产物存放到OSS（含内置和用户）的加密类型

KbUuidList.description_en: The list of knowledge base IDs for the current session
KbUuidList.description_zh: 本次会话的知识库ID列表

items.description_en: The ID of a single knowledge base

Language.description_en:
The language. Valid values:
CHINESE: Chinese.
ENGLISH: English
Language.description_zh:
语言
CHINESE 中文
ENGLISH 英语

McpServerIds.description_en: The list of MCP server IDs in the session configuration
McpServerIds.description_zh: 会话配置中的MCP服务器ID列表

items.description_en: The MCP server ID in the session configuration

McpServerIds.title_en: 会话配置中的MCP服务器ID列表
McpServerIds.title_zh: 会话配置中的MCP服务器ID列表

Mode.description_en:
The mode. Valid values:
ASK_DATA: ask data mode.
ANALYSIS: analysis mode.
INSIGHT: insight mode
Mode.description_zh:
模式：
ASK_DATA 问数模式
ANALYSIS 分析模式
INSIGHT 洞察模式

UserOssBucket.description_en:
The name of the user OSS bucket.
Analysis process files and report artifacts can be uploaded to the user-specified OSS bucket
UserOssBucket.description_zh:
用户OSS Bucket名称
分析过程文件、报告产物可上传到用户指定的OSS Bucket

Title.example: 分析一下这份文件，给出报告。

UserId.description_en: The ID of the session owner

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned when the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误信息

Success.description_en:
The return value. Valid values:

true: Succeeded.
false: Failed
Success.description_zh:
返回值说明。

true：删除成功。
false：删除失败
